label: PF Backlog 534
title: Simplify grooming + dedup: fill fields/priority/deps; dedup stays deterministic (score); review/approve must not use AI duplication_findings as a duplicate signal
body:
## Problem
Grooming was expected to be simple: fill the available fields (objective/acceptance_criteria/in_scope/out_of_scope/affected_*/approach/verification/risks/rollback/evidence) + priority + structured dependencies, with AI or deterministic. Instead, the review/approve surface conflates two different concepts:
- Deterministic dedup = find_similar similarity SCORE vs a threshold (PF_DEDUP_THRESHOLD, default 0.6) -> possible_duplicate_of (BI-PF-0432/0434). Probability-based; this worked.
- AI duplication_findings = the model's ADVISORY list of related/reusable items, which is non-empty on nearly every item. review/approve read this and labeled it 'duplication', so it looks like everything is a duplicate and approve-all blocks everything. Confusing.

## Goal
Simplify grooming to: fill fields + priority + deps (AI or deterministic) and keep dedup deterministic (score threshold). review/approve must not treat AI duplication_findings (advisory) as a duplicate/blocking signal.

## In scope
- review/approve: remove the AI duplication_findings-based 'duplication' flag/block; keep missing-info as advisory (non-blocking)
- blocking signals limited to hard ones: consolidation_proposal, low confidence, context_review implementable == False
- rely on the deterministic possible_duplicate_of (score threshold) for real duplicate detection
- keep grooming = fill fields/priority/deps simple (AI default, deterministic fallback)

## Out of scope
- changing the deterministic dedup threshold/algorithm
- removing AI analysis fields

## Acceptance
- plain `groom-all` then `approve-all` works without --force for AI-groomed, implementable items.
- AI duplication_findings do not block approval; deterministic possible_duplicate_of still surfaced.
- tests updated.

## Approach
decide_all/review: base flags on hard signals only; treat duplication_findings/missing_info as informational; keep the deterministic dedup threshold as the duplicate authority.

brief.what_adds: Restrict approve/review blocking to hard signals (consolidation, low-confidence, unimplementable); treat AI duplication_findings/missing_info as informational.

approve-all approves AI-groomed implementable items without --force; blocks only on consolidation/low-confidence/unimplementable.
Deterministic dedup (score threshold, possible_duplicate_of) remains the duplicate authority.
